applicant_utility.summary: This is one of the few genuinely full packages in the catalogue: tuition, a EUR 1,550 monthly stipend for 13 or 25 months, visa costs and insurance are all covered, and UM even allocates you a room. The catch is the funnel: only about 2% of applicants win, and the scholarship cannot even be started until your Studielink master's file is complete by 10 December 2026, a month before the 1 February 2027 scholarship deadline. Refusing the mandatory room cancels the scholarship, and airfares are not covered, so budget separately for your flight.
applicant_utility.best_fit: High-achieving non-EU/EEA applicants aged 35 or under with a GPA of 7.5 or higher who need full funding and can commit to the ambassador role.
application_readiness_checklist: Complete the Studielink application and every admission requirement before 10 December 2026; this is the real gate
Pay any programme handling fee by 10 December 2026 yourself, since the scholarship does not cover it
Request a reference letter dated no earlier than February 2026 from a professor, lecturer or employer, following the UM guidelines
Prepare a document explaining your country's grading system alongside the transcript showing GPA 7.5+
Draft the financial-needs statement honestly; the committee reads it against your motivation letter
Check whether your programme is on the 2027-2028 participating list before investing in the application
common_rejection_risks: An incomplete master's application file at the 10 December 2026 Studielink cut-off
A GPA below 7.5 out of 10, including because the grading system was not explained
Prior degree-seeking study in the Netherlands; completed exchanges are fine but degrees are not
Submitting more than one UM scholarship application, which disqualifies all of them
Adding or replacing documents after submission, which the portal does not allow
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Air tickets and the roughly EUR 75 room cleaning fee are not covered; two-year scholars must find and pay their own housing for the second year after 16 July 2028, and programme handling fees are the applicant's responsibility.
document_audit: The CV is capped at two A4 pages and should mention awards or prizes
The reference letter must use the UM guidelines and be uploaded by you, not sent by the referee
Referee contact details must include relationship, work phone with country code and an institutional email; personal addresses are a red flag
Uploads are limited to .doc, .docx or PDF formats
alerts: Accepting the scholarship means accepting the allocated UM room; refusing it cancels the award
Only one UM scholarship application per student; multiple applications are disqualified
The application portal was unavailable between 22 and 26 October for an upgrade, so start early
You commit to presenting your experience at at least one information session during and after your studies
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Complete the participating master's application via Studielink by 10 December 2026, log in to the UM scholarship form once your student ID exists, upload the full document set by 1 February 2027 23:59 CET, pass completeness checking and faculty ranking, attend an online interview if shortlisted, then receive a status in April 2027 final by May.

verification.notes: Official University of Twente Scholarship page read in full on 2026-10-10. The brief's URL returned 404; the live scholarship-finder page above confirms the EUR 3,000-22,000 range, the no-tuition-paid wording, the IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL 90 plus speaking 6.0 requirement, the exclusions (Dutch, current UT, EU/EEA, statutory-fee payers, ITC, pre-Master), the 15 October 2026 opening and 1 April 2027 16:00 CET closing dates, the second-year progress conditions and first-week-of-May results.

applicant_utility.summary: The UTS is a cash award between EUR 3,000 and EUR 22,000 that you spend however you like; UT pays no tuition on your behalf, and the page bluntly tells applicants who cannot cover the remaining costs not to apply at all. Your admission letter is the entry ticket, and the scholarship form only opens on 15 October 2026 with your student number. If you land it, note that applying for the UTS is also the only route to the Kipaji Scholarship, so indicate your interest in the motivation field.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Top-5-to-10-percent graduates from non-EU/EEA countries holding a conditional admission to an eligible UT English-taught master's, who can self-fund tuition.
application_readiness_checklist: Apply for the master's programme first; admission can take up to eight weeks, so start early enough to hold the letter before April
Confirm your programme is not an ITC or pre-Master programme before applying
Have your academic IELTS 6.5 (or TOEFL iBT 90) with 6.0 in speaking ready, since eligibility depends on it
Indicate interest in the Kipaji Scholarship in the application motivation if relevant
Model your full budget against UT's published cost-of-living and tuition-fee pages before deciding to apply
common_rejection_risks: Being, or becoming, eligible for the statutory tuition fee: if you receive the UTS and later qualify, the scholarship is cancelled and payments stop
Any Dutch or current-UT student status, or EU/EEA nationality
Applying for an ITC programme or continuing from the pre-Master
Missing that only one UT scholarship can be awarded per student
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Tuition fees and all living costs remain yours; UT directs applicants to its cost-of-living and tuition-fee pages and warns that the UTS is not a full scholarship.
document_audit: The page publishes no document list; the application itself is completed in the online form with your student number
Proof of top-5-to-10-percent class standing rests on your application; there is no separate certificate upload described
The English subscore rule is specific: speaking must reach 6.0 (TOEFL iBT 20), so an overall pass is not enough
alerts: If you become eligible for the statutory tuition fee after receiving the award, you must inform the UT Scholarship Coordinator immediately and the scholarship is cancelled
Only one UT scholarship per student, so do not spread applications across several UT awards
Admission processing can take up to eight weeks, which compresses the window between your admission letter and the 1 April 2027 deadline
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Receive a (conditional) admission letter for a qualifying 2027/2028 master's, log in with your UT student number when the form opens on 15 October 2026, complete the UTS application before 1 April 2027 16:00 CET, and await results in the first week of May 2027.
